verses.raw: And Manāt, the third - the other one?<sup foot_note=256810>1</sup>

verses.raw: Is the male for you and for Him the female?

verses.raw: That, then, is an unjust division.<sup foot_note=256812>1</sup>

verses.raw: They are not but [mere] names you have named them - you and your forefathers - for which Allāh has sent down no authority. They follow not except assumption and what [their] souls desire, and there has already come to them from their Lord guidance.
